title: protium copal
intro: Protium copal, commonly known as Bursera bipinnata, is a plant species in the Burseraceae family native to Central and South America. The Protium copal plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, fighting against fungal and bacterial infections, and providing antioxidant and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Protium copal include its use in traditional medicine to treat respiratory issues, wounds, and skin conditions, as well as its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve stress. The bioactive constituents present in the Protium copal plant include sesquiterpenes, diterpenes, and triterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
